readme: midi-keys — a MIDI keyboard playing a plucked string.
keys (midiin) --notes--> pluck (karplus) --> verb --> master
keys signal (mod wheel, cc 1) --> pluck.damping
knob (midicc cc 74) --> verb.gain
'keys' listens to every connected MIDI input (the browser asks for MIDI
permission once). Keys sound while held and let go on key-up; the sustain
pedal holds them. The mod wheel darkens the string, the cc 74 knob (often
labelled cutoff) rides the reverb. Notes only sound after /start.
Try:
/start
/devices                     list MIDI inputs (and audio devices)
/keys device=arturia         listen to one device (a fragment of its name)
/keys channel=2              one MIDI channel (0 = all)
/keys release=1              a slower fade on key-up
/keys transpose=-12          an octave down
/knob cc=71                  follow a different knob (or cc=pitchbend)
/add_modulator type=midicc name=fader cc=7   one midicc per control
/pluck synth=czsynth         any synth plays from the same cable
A midiin also fires on every key, so modlfo strike=keys or
randomnotes trigger=keys follow the keyboard too.
